meta_description: Southampton Gas & Plumbing Ltd offer expert gas and plumbing services across Southampton. Gas Safe registered, fast response, free quotes. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Serving Southampton & Hampshire
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, and gas faults fixed fast — reliable local engineers you can call on today.
services_heading: Complete Gas & Plumbing Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full bathroom installations, we cover every gas and plumbing need for homes and businesses across Southampton and Hampshire.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Our Gas Safe engineers diagnose and fix boiler faults quickly, restoring your heating and hot water with minimal disruption. Annual servicing packages keep your boiler running efficiently and your warranty valid.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: We supply and install energy-efficient boilers from leading brands, tailored to the size and demands of your property. Every installation includes full commissioning and handover so you're confident from day one.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: From full system installations to power flushing and radiator upgrades, we ensure your home heats evenly and efficiently. We'll identify cold spots and pressure issues and fix them for good.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or a blocked drain causing chaos? Our engineers are on call for rapid response across Southampton to prevent costly water damage. No call-out charge applies to booked emergencies.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: We handle complete bathroom refits, including new suites, tiling, and all associated plumbing and pipework. Whether it's a simple upgrade or a full redesign, we deliver a clean, professional finish every time.

services.title: Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Landlords and homeowners can book a Gas Safe inspection and receive a certified CP12 certificate the same day in most cases. Stay compliant, protect your tenants, and avoid costly penalties.

about_pullquote: We do the job right first time — every time, for every customer.
about_para_1: Southampton Gas & Plumbing Ltd was founded by experienced local engineers who saw a clear need for a reliable, honest gas and plumbing service in Southampton and the surrounding Hampshire area. Based in Hedge End, we've built the business from the ground up by prioritising quality workmanship and straightforward communication with every customer we serve.
about_para_2: Our Gas Safe registered engineers bring expertise across the full range of domestic and commercial plumbing and heating services. Customers return to us time and again because we turn up when we say we will, explain the work clearly, and never add hidden charges to the final bill.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. The engineer arrived within a couple of hours, diagnosed the boiler fault straight away, and had us back up and running the same afternoon. Really fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Used Southampton Gas & Plumbing for a full boiler replacement. They were professional, tidy, and explained everything clearly. The new boiler was fitted and commissioned in a day. Couldn't ask for more.
reviews.author: James R.

reviews.text: Called them out for a burst pipe on a Sunday evening and they were with me in under an hour. Sorted the problem quickly and left the place spotless. Genuine, trustworthy local tradesmen — will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michelle B.
